1) 执行 echo ruok | nc \u003chost\u003e 21: 1) Run echo ruok | nc <host> 2181 to reproduce it by hand, then echo srvr | nc <host> 2181 to read Mode and Connections; 2) Check whether the 4lw allowlist (4lw.commands.whitelist in zoo.cfg) is rejecting the probe — that is a false positive, just open the allowlist; 3) For a genuine problem, check the log for JVM full GC or a full disk; 4) Run echo mntr | nc <host> 2181 and check whether zk_outstanding_requests is piling up, which means it can no longer keep up.
1) 登录主机确认进程是否存活（jps 或 systemctl status z: 1) Log in to the host and confirm the process is alive (jps or systemctl status zookeeper); 2) If it is alive, run echo ruok | nc <host> 2181 and see whether it answers imok, to tell a hung process apart from a network problem; 3) If it is not running, check zookeeper.out or the files under logs/ for the exit reason — a full disk and JVM OOM are the most common; 4) After restarting, run echo srvr | nc <host> 2181 to confirm it rejoined the cluster and finished syncing.
1) 逐个节点执行 echo srvr | nc \u003chost\u003: 1) Run echo srvr | nc <host> 2181 on each node and read Mode to confirm whether the number of live nodes has fallen below quorum; 2) If quorum is lost, bring the downed nodes back first — the cluster elects a leader automatically once the majority is restored; 3) If all nodes are alive but no leader is elected, check connectivity on ports 2888/3888 and whether any myid is duplicated; 4) Check the election errors in each node's log — a corrupted transaction log is common, in which case sync a snapshot from another node and restart.

1) Run echo srvr | nc <host> 2181 on each node and read the Mode each one reports, to see how many claim to be leader; 2) Check that the server.N list in zoo.cfg is identical on every node — an inconsistent configuration is the most common cause of split brain; 3) Check connectivity and partitioning on ports 2888/3888 between nodes; 4) Once confirmed, stop the minority side so the cluster re-elects a leader, then bring those nodes back one at a time.
ZooKeeper 的 ruok 探测没有返回 imok，进程还在但已经不能正常: The ZooKeeper ruok probe did not answer imok: the process is still running but can no longer serve, and requests will time out.
ZooKeeper 集群没有 leader，无法处理任何写请求，依赖它的 Kaf: The ZooKeeper cluster has no leader and cannot process any write request; components that depend on it, such as Kafka and HBase, will immediately fail their writes.
同一个 ZooKeeper 集群里出现了多于一个 leader，即脑裂，此时不同: More than one leader appeared in the same ZooKeeper cluster, i.e. split brain; different clients may read conflicting data and any component using ZooKeeper for leader election or distributed locks becomes unpredictable.
采集端已连不上 ZooKeeper 节点，进程可能已退出，依赖它做选主与元数据存: The collector can no longer reach the ZooKeeper node; the process may have exited, affecting every component that relies on it for leader election and metadata storage.
